sites.residue_label: gap junction vestibule (E1 or E2 extracellular loop)
sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: HA immunolabeling confirmed at gap junction plaques (surface); gap junction function confirmed by biotinylation flux through Cx43 channels into adjacent uninfected cells (function preserved).
sites.rationale: L5 and L6 report a full-length Cx43 construct with an HA tag detectable by immunolabeling at gap junction plaques; SMLM places the HA within the gap junction vestibule (extracellular-facing entrance to the channel pore). Gap junction function is directly confirmed by biotinylation flux into adjacent cells. This is a distinct paper (PMC13322983) and construct from L1/L2; the vestibule description is less specific than 'E2 apex' and could encompass E1 (43–71) as well as E2 (177–207), so it is reported as a separate site. No specific residue or loop is named, so insert_after_residue is null. Full-length Cx43 fusion construct ('astrocyte network tracer') expressed in astrocytes via viral infection; HA tag is part of the construct and is detectable by immunolabeling in gap junction plaques; single-molecule localization microscopy (SMLM) confirms HA localizes within the gap junction vestibule (extracellular-facing channel entrance formed by E1 and E2 loops).

Destination clones expressing Cx43-eGFP and LifeAct-mCherry were generated using the converted vectors pDEST-eGFP-N1 and pDEST-mCherry-N1 as previously described. 8
We targeted the relatively variable region between the two peripheral cysteines at the apex of E2 for tag insertion with a glycine–proline-linked nine residue HA sequence via site-directed mutagenesis, restriction enzyme digestion, and ligation.

sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (9 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: Two extracellular surface sites are supported by the ledger. Site 1 (L1/L2, PMC3621031): HA tag explicitly placed in the E2 loop of full-length Cx43 between peripheral cysteines C187 and C198; no specific residue number given, so reported at region level. Site 2 (L5/L6, PMC13322983): HA tag in the gap junction vestibule of a full-length Cx43 fusion construct, confirmed by immunolabeling and SMLM; gap junction function confirmed by biotinylation flux; the exact loop is unspecified ('vestibule' encompasses E1 43–71 and E2 177–207). Four ledger lines (L3, L4, L7, L8) report C-terminal tags on full-length Cx43; the C-terminus (residue 382, 'I') is intracellular (topology span 229–382) and these are recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports an insertion in E1 with a specific residue, nor any N-terminal extracellular tag (N-terminus residues 1–23 are intracellular). No ledger line reports a function-abrogating insertion.
